scope: npm dependency tree including development tools

advisories.title: braces vulnerable to stack-exhaustion denial of service through deeply nested patterns
node-forge RSA PKCS#1 v1.5 signature verification accepts extra nested DigestAlgorithm elements

note: Counts include transitive propagation, not distinct vulnerabilities. npm 12.2.0 reports 33 high, zero moderate and two root advisories after the UUID fix. No advisory filter, forced Expo downgrade, graph-validation waiver or release approval was applied.
